nphi.title: National Inventory of Dangerous Pathogens in Sri Lanka
nphi.with: UN BWC Implementation Support Unit; Netherlands MFA; EU
nphi.summary: Set up a national dangerous-pathogen inventory in Sri Lanka and trained stakeholders on dual-use risk; one training was held in Thailand.

nphi.title: IDEA-ALL – Alliance for identifying emerging pathogens (GHPP)
nphi.with: Medical Research Institute; University of Colombo; Colombo North Teaching Hospital; Ministry of Health; WHO Country Office Sri Lanka
nphi.summary: Strengthens laboratory diagnostics, surveillance and infection prevention in Sri Lanka, with a focus on zoonotic viral infections. It succeeds the IDEAnet project.

nphi.title: ICMR/DHR regional dialogue on strengthening health research systems
nphi.with: National health research bodies of Bhutan, Nepal, Sri Lanka and Timor-Leste
nphi.summary: ICMR offered ethics forms and free training to partners and agreed regular exchanges and joint capacity building on AMR, NCDs, One Health and field epidemiology.

nphi.title: Fleming Fund Fellowships phase 2 – Bangladesh and Sri Lanka (host institution CUHK)
nphi.actor: Chinese University of Hong Kong (Jockey Club School of Public Health and Primary Care)
nphi.with: Fleming Fund (UK DHSC); Mott MacDonald; government and research laboratories in Bangladesh and Sri Lanka
nphi.summary: CUHK hosts phase 2 Fleming Fellowships (2024–2025) that mentor fellows from public health, disease control and laboratory institutions in Bangladesh and Sri Lanka on One Health AMR surveillance.

nphi.title: China CDC – GOARN Tier 1.5 and training-of-trainers workshop for Asian responders
nphi.with: WHO Global Outbreak Alert and Response Network (GOARN); Guangdong Provincial CDC; national public health agencies of the participating countries
nphi.summary: China CDC and GOARN ran a three-day workshop in Guangzhou on deploying international public health emergency teams. It covered GOARN Tier 1.5 training and training of trainers for participants from eight ASEAN countries, Sri Lanka and…

nphi.title: IDEAnet – Network for the identification of emerging agents
nphi.with: University of Colombo (DOZES lab, IBMBB); Ministry of Health; Medical Research Institute; National Institute of Health Sciences; Veterinary Research Institute; Jaffna Teaching Hospital; National Hospital Kandy; Colombo North Teaching Hospital (Sri Lanka); WHO
nphi.summary: One Health lab network for diagnosing endemic and emerging viruses (incl. Nipah preparedness) in Sri Lanka.

nphi.title: ICMR-NIV mpox diagnostic training for South and Southeast Asian countries
nphi.with: Health and laboratory staff of nine South and Southeast Asian countries
nphi.summary: During the 2022 mpox outbreak, ICMR-NIV Pune trained health workers from nine Asian countries in mpox testing, case definitions, sample collection and lab equipment. It also offered testing kits, reagents and probes on request.

nphi.title: IDEA – Identification of emerging agents in Sri Lanka
nphi.with: University of Colombo; North Colombo Teaching Hospital Ragama (Sri Lanka)
nphi.summary: Strengthened diagnostics to detect emerging infectious diseases and investigate viral outbreaks.

nphi.title: PPE – Partnership in postgraduate education
nphi.with: Centre Muraz (Burkina Faso); CHU Bouaké (Côte d'Ivoire); Kinshasa University Hospital (DR Congo); LAUTECH, NCDC, Obafemi Awolowo University, University of Ibadan (Nigeria); Naval Hospital Medical Center (Peru); Epidemiology Bureau DOH (Philippines); University of Pretoria (South Africa); Colombo Teaching Hospital Ragama (Sri Lanka); Central Laboratory (Sudan); Avicenna Tajik State Medical University (Tajikistan); Charles Nicolle Hospital (Tunisia)
nphi.summary: Train-the-trainer postgraduate stays at RKI in lab diagnostics and epidemiology for partner-country scientists.

nphi.title: D:APS – Deployment: assessment, planning and support
nphi.with: WHO/GOARN; German Federal Foreign Office; BfArM; BNITM; PEI (Germany)
nphi.summary: Managed RKI deployments to international outbreak investigations on request of WHO/GOARN or partners.

nphi.title: Workshop for field epidemiology officials from Asian countries (CFETP, MOFCOM-funded)
nphi.actor: China CDC (China Field Epidemiology Training Program)
nphi.with: NHFPC International Exchange and Cooperation Center; Ministry of Commerce (aid training)
nphi.summary: CFETP hosted a three-week aid-funded workshop in Beijing for 20 field epidemiology officials from seven Asian countries. It was the second such workshop for Asian countries, and a 2015 round followed.

nphi.title: Regional Field Epidemiology Training Programme for South-East Asia at NCDC India
nphi.actor: National Centre for Disease Control (NCDC), India
nphi.summary: NCDC, a WHO collaborating centre for epidemiology and training, runs a regional field epidemiology course for health staff from WHO South-East Asia Region countries.
